description: Approximate positions and search aliases for the areas, towns/tehsils and a few landmarks named in the Faisalabad water-filtration-plant spreadsheet. Positions are area-level references for browsing and are NEVER a plant's location. Only geocodeStatus "matched" (or an administrator's "manual" edit in the database) is usable for public ranking.
license: Compilation © Team Water contributors. Coordinates come from Who's On First (original work CC0; this subset carries GeoNames data under CC BY and Wikidata data under CC0; see sources). Tehsil membership was checked against geoBoundaries PAK ADM3 (ODbL 1.0; used for verification only, no geometry copied). Aliases and Urdu transliterations are original work.
attribution: Place positions: Who's On First (https://whosonfirst.org/docs/licenses/), incl. data from GeoNames (CC BY, https://www.geonames.org/) and Wikidata (CC0).

entries.name: Faisalabad

entries.name: Jaranwala
